convert_locators_to_skinned_locators: convert regular locators to skinned locators with bone weights from the character mesh
convert_skinned_locators_to_locators: convert skinned locators back to regular locators attached to the highest-weight bone
process_markers: run marker tracking on a character given marker data and tracking configuration
get_locator_error: compute average and maximum error between marker positions and locator positions across frames
create_tracking_config: create a TrackingConfig with max iterations, visibility threshold, and regularization parameters
